verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's MCP server and agent-skills let an AI agent investigate incidents, diagnose latency/error spikes, and answer questions using live telemetry, and Query Assistant translates natural language into queries — these support AI-assisted incident investigation, but there is no direct evidence of an automated 'incident summary' artifact delivered to responders as part of alerting/triggers. Missing for 10: a documented feature that auto-generates a written incident/alert summary (vs. requiring an agent to be manually queried), and evidence of this integrated into the trigger/SLO notification flow.
